name: s-kaupat-mcp
description: Find S-kaupat stores, search groceries and fill your S-kaupat shopping lists.
long_description:
Lets Claude use the S-kaupat.fi grocery store: choose your store (Prisma, S-market, Alepa, Sale and others), search and browse products with current prices, read ingredients, allergens and nutrition, and fill your S-kaupat shopping lists. You finish on the S-kaupat site by pressing "Lisää kaikki ostoskoriin" on the list and checking out; this extension never places orders or touches payment.

Shopping lists need you to log in once to your S-kaupat account in a small window the extension opens (Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome must be installed). Only the login's renewal token is kept, in Windows Credential Manager on Windows.

While Claude uses S-kaupat, a small Edge (or Chrome) window with the S-kaupat site runs minimised in the taskbar; the extension sends its requests from that page and closes the window after 10 idle minutes.

Unofficial: not made or endorsed by S Group.
